profile.name: Ahrorbek Tulkinov
profile.title: International Business & Relations Specialist
profile.subTitle: Global Sales & Cross-Border Expansion Manager
profile.summary: At Milliard Club and Surprise Ice Cream, I lead international sales and export operations, bringing premium products and strategic partnerships to global markets. With a Bachelor's degree in Economics & Finance from Westminster International University in Tashkent, I specialize in market expansion, cross-border partnerships, financial oversight, and streamlined export operations.

experience.description: Leading global export operations, expanding brand footprint into new regional markets, and optimizing international trade channels.
responsibilities: Formulating and executing international market expansion strategies across Central and East Asia.
Managing B2B distributor relationships, international trade negotiations, and export compliance.
Coordinating cross-border supply chain logistics and cold-chain distribution channels.
achievements: Successfully launched brand presence and export channels across 3 new international territories.
Increased export sales volume by 35% through strategic B2B distribution agreements.
Optimized export supply chain workflows, reducing cross-border transit times by 15%.

experience.description: Spearheaded global HR branding, cross-border employer partnerships, and international relocation programs.
responsibilities: Leading global talent acquisition strategies and cross-border recruitment across 5 countries.
Negotiating and securing B2B partnership contracts with foreign employers and recruitment agencies.
Designing and executing expat relocation, visa processing, and adaptation frameworks.
Organizing international job fairs and marketing campaigns to build global employer branding.
achievements: Hired over 50 international specialists across 5 countries within one year, growing international headcount by 20%.
Negotiated & signed agreements with 3 foreign employers generating $500,000 in revenue.
Established partnerships with 5 foreign agencies, expanding recruitment pool by 30%.
Designed relocation & adaptation framework achieving an 80% 1-year retention rate for expat personnel.
Hosted 2 international job fairs connecting 100+ candidates with 15 employers.
Boosted foreign applications by 40% and secured 5 new enterprise clients through global marketing campaigns.
